text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: First place... I won! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All that training paid off, and I've<n>gotten closer to
running the way I<n>want!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...But I can't get complacent. I have to<n>strive for
even more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You should've said something if you<n>were standing
there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You scared me! I guess I was so<n>happy I didn't
even realize you were<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So, uh... How'd I do today?
choice_data_list: I could tell you ran your very best.
I think there's still room for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So, uh... How'd I do today?
choice_data_list: I could tell you ran your very best.
I think there's still room for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Really? I was feeling it myself, but<n>now that I hear
someone else say it...<n>Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm going to keep this up for<n>my next race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you have even<n>greater
expectations for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I want to keep reaching<n>for greater
heights too!
